scope: R182: first successful build, install and execution of the H3RangeStats custom op

build_solutions.pythonpath_shadow_root_cause: CANN's bin/asc_opc prepends its own site-packages to PYTHONPATH, shadowing every external overlay
build_solutions.solution_1: private asc_opc wrapper importing opc.py with the overlay first
build_solutions.solution_2_recommended: wrap bisheng itself on PATH; CANN resolves it via shutil.which, so this covers every device compile on both soc paths

soc_correction.evidence: runtime error: SoC version ascend910 verification failed; this SoC is not configured through AddConfig
soc_correction.note: the original task target did say 8x910A

op_host_fixes_required: InferShape must produce [H3_CORE_NUM], not copy the input shape
InferDataType must produce DT_INT32, not propagate the input dtype
TilingFunc must set tiling->coreNum, which the skeleton left unset

correctness.adversarial_passes: 6/15 and the passes are coincidental, not correct
correctness.symptom: maxMag exceeds 16 bits and repeats across unrelated inputs, which means the value read back is not the value the kernel wrote
correctness.prime_suspect: the output write: yGm_ is set to y+coreIdx with a length of 1, yet DataCopy(yGm_, oc, 8) writes 8 ints per core, so the 8 cores overwrite each other
other_suspects: ReduceMax Level-2 dst size/alignment and whether GetValue(0) reads the right slot
VECCALC buffer aliasing with the ReduceMax shared temporary buffer
correctness.adoption: NOT adopted; the timing result stands on its own but the operator is unusable until the verdicts are right

stage_a_status: the performance premise is confirmed and better than expected at 2.68 s, so the remaining question is correctness rather than whether it is worth doing

compliance.vendor_install: custom op package installed into opp/vendors, the CANN-supported extension location
